name: Login
purpose: Email and password sign-in fragment composed from form, input, password-input, and button.
scenarios: Sign in to a product with email and password
Reveal or hide the password field
Jump to the register scene from the login card

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onSubmit.description: Called with email, password, and remember after client validation.

onRegisterClick.description: Called when the create-account action is activated.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

antiPatterns: Do not collect passwords in a plain text input when password-input is available.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

a11y.focus: Fields and actions remain in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Email, password, remember, and submit have visible labels.

responsive.strategy: Single-column card with max-inline-size; compact viewports keep 44px targets via tokens.

breakpoints.compact: Card uses full inline size with 44px targets.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language, never a hardcoded ltr attribute.
